Use N, mm, and MPa units throughout.
Assume Euler–Bernoulli beam theory with small deflections and linear elastic material behavior.
The cantilever beam has length L = 1800 mm, fixed at x = 0 and free at x = L.
Use structural steel with E = 200000 MPa and constant second moment of area I = 1200000 mm^4.
Apply a downward point load P = 2000 N at the free end.
Do not use the constant-moment assumption or zero-free-end-rotation assumption.
Compute the free-end slope using theta = P L^2 / (2 E I).
Compute the free-end deflection using delta = P L^3 / (3 E I).
Report the free-end slope as 0.0135 rad, approximately 0.77 degrees.
Report the free-end vertical deflection as 16.2 mm downward.
